rsi_adx.economic_rationale: Falsify whether short-term exhaustion plus trend strength has a broad net-positive region.

seven_day_pullback.economic_rationale: Test bounded trend-filtered pullback horizons without rescuing a failed family through unlimited filters.

ma_channel.economic_rationale: Test whether channel persistence survives neighboring lookbacks and realistic portfolio costs.

ma_crossover.economic_rationale: Test a broad slow-trend region and reject isolated fast/slow sweet spots.

asymmetric_ma_crossover.economic_rationale: Test separate entry and exit speeds with structural fast/slow constraints.

bollinger_breakout.economic_rationale: Test volatility-normalized breakouts across broad periods and band widths.

market_structure_atr_pullback.economic_rationale: Stress a breakout-pullback model that previously exhibited unacceptable drawdown.

five_bar_contrarian.economic_rationale: Falsification study for a prior out-of-sample collapse.

percent_flipper.economic_rationale: Test trend thresholds independently while flagging boundary dependence.

rotational_momentum.economic_rationale: Test monthly causal cross-sectional momentum with bounded ranking and trend gates.

triple_screen.economic_rationale: Multi-timeframe family; weekly features must use only completed weeks.

reference_sources.notes: VWAP, RSI, ADX and ATR formulas may inform registered research; its standalone capital engine is not imported.
External data and hub orchestration are excluded from the local PIT campaign.
Mathematical ideas may be reviewed, but the module must never be imported by offline parameter research.
